description: Power, device-reported energy, electrical readings and exporter diagnostics for pyprom-exporters. Portable Prometheus data source and regex-safe fleet filters; no external plugins.

options.content:
**Power in W · energy in Wh · exporter health.** Filter your devices above.  
Energy follows each plug’s calendar. Blank readings mean unavailable data.

panels.title: Read the fleet at a glance

panels.description: Prometheus scrape health across selected exporters. A successful scrape does not prove that every plug refreshed. No targets means the job or exporter selection has no matching target.
panels.title: Exporter

panels.description: Count of selected device power series in the latest successful scrape. This is not an online count; unsupported, missing and failed readings are omitted. Repeated monitoring of one physical plug by different exporters counts more than once.
panels.title: Reporting plugs

panels.description: Sum of available selected device power readings in watts. Missing devices are not estimated; this can be a partial fleet total.
panels.title: Power now

panels.description: Sum of available device-reported energy today, in Wh. Resets at each plug’s local midnight, not the browser timezone. Not energy over the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: Energy today

panels.description: Sum of available device-reported energy this calendar month, in Wh. Resets at each plug’s month boundary. Not a lifetime counter or energy over the selected dashboard range.
panels.title: Energy month

panels.description: Seconds since the most recent Prometheus scrape attempt, successful or failed. This is not the age of the device reading: a timed-out live refresh can return the previous snapshot. Inspect scrape status and exporter logs.
panels.title: Scrape age

panels.description: Instantaneous watts per device and the sum of available readings. Gaps remain visible; a zero reading is a real reported zero. Host and exporter distinguish repeated aliases.
panels.title: Power over time

panels.description: Up to ten selected devices with the highest current reported wattage. Rankings omit unavailable readings.
panels.title: Largest loads now · top 10

panels.description: Device-reported gauge in Wh, shown without rate or increase. It resets at midnight in the plug’s timezone. Missing samples remain gaps; a reset is expected. Unsupported devices have no series.
panels.title: Energy accumulated today

panels.description: Device-reported gauge in Wh, shown without rate or increase. It resets at the month boundary in the plug’s timezone. Missing samples remain gaps; a reset is expected. Unsupported devices have no series.
panels.title: Energy accumulated this month

panels.description: Available device readings only. Hardware and firmware capabilities vary; no data does not mean a zero reading. No universal alarm threshold is imposed because regional supply and plug ratings differ.
panels.title: Voltage

panels.description: Available device readings only. Hardware and firmware capabilities vary; no data does not mean a zero reading. No universal alarm threshold is imposed because regional supply and plug ratings differ.
panels.title: Current

panels.description: Reported received signal strength in dBm. Values closer to zero indicate stronger reception. Not a connectivity or packet-loss measurement.
panels.title: Wi-Fi signal over time

panels.description: Signal strength where supported. Indicative display bands: below −80 dBm weak, −80 to −65 dBm fair, above −65 dBm stronger. These are display guidance, not alerts.
panels.title: Wi-Fi signal now
Exporter health · all hosts on selected exporters

panels.description: All discovered devices retained by the selected exporters. Host/device filters do not apply. This may include unsupported or failed devices and is not an online count.
panels.title: Inventory

panels.description: Samples from the latest scrape across selected exporters, including process metrics. Host/device filters do not apply. A failed scrape may report zero.
panels.title: Samples

panels.description: Latest longest scrape duration among selected exporters. Live probing contributes to this duration. Compare with the configured Prometheus scrape timeout; this stack defaults to 25 seconds.
panels.title: Longest scrape

panels.description: Total resident memory reported by the selected exporter processes. Optional process metrics may be absent on unsupported platforms.
panels.title: Memory

panels.description: CPU seconds per wall-clock second across selected exporters; 1 means one fully busy core. This is a counter rate, independent of the plug energy gauges. At least two process samples are required.
panels.title: CPU · cores

panels.description: Prometheus targets matching the job/exporter filters, whether their latest scrape succeeded or failed. Host/device filters do not apply.
panels.title: Targets

panels.description: Duration of each scrape attempt, including live probing and serialization. Sustained values near the timeout need investigation in exporter logs or a smaller device concurrency/polling workload.
panels.title: Scrape duration over time

panels.description: 1 means Prometheus fetched and parsed an exporter response; 0 means the scrape failed. This is exporter reachability, not individual plug freshness or relay state.
panels.title: Scrape success over time

options.content:
**Start with exporter scrape status.** If it fails, check the Prometheus target and exporter logs. If it succeeds but plug data is missing, check configured hosts, LAN reachability, Tapo credentials and device capabilities.

**A successful scrape can contain an older snapshot.** The exporter does not expose a device update timestamp or per-device online/relay state. Scrape age cannot establish reading freshness; consult exporter logs if values stop changing. Discovered inventory includes retained devices with failed updates.

**Energy is device-reported Wh.** Today/month gauges reset on the plug’s calendar. They are not counters and are not converted into hourly/yearly estimates. Historical `kasa_*` data remains in Prometheus but is not combined with these different metrics.
